title: Loops se naam pattern
solution:
let str = "Sheryians"
let rev = ""
for (let ch of str) rev = ch + rev
console.log(rev)
for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) console.log("*".repeat(i))
let a = 0, b = 1
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
  console.log(a)
  let next = a + b
  a = b
  b = next
}
hints: ch + rev se naya char pehle aata hai
